notes: A clean run with CO2_limit = -1 tCO2. Emissions are a non-negative quantity, so 'emissions <= -1' is unsatisfiable for every capacity plan and every dispatch — no numeric or parameter change can rescue it. RE_limit = 0 makes the renewable floor inert so the cap is the ONLY binding policy constraint. The only feasibility-restoring changes (raise CO2_limit, set clean='reference') are Tier C, so the correct behaviour is to stop and ask. Dispatch on maluku so it fails in seconds.
